title: SourceDerivationLink
description: Immutable protected claim-level provenance edge from a source region or approved generated origin to a candidate and optionally exact learning target.

authoring_run_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized CurriculumAuthoringRun in the owning institution.

source_region_id.description: Exact accepted source region when the classification requires one.
source_region_id.x-reference-scope: Must be a sealed accepted region in the run exact source set and still readable under the source rights and scope.

candidate_id.description: Stable candidate identity inside the run.

target_kind.description: Candidate-only or exact owner version target.

content_node_version_id.description: Optional exact owner target version selected by target_kind.
content_node_version_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and authorized target ancestry. Exact revision must match the authenticated owner receipt.

activity_version_id.description: Optional exact owner target version selected by target_kind.
activity_version_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and authorized target ancestry. Exact revision must match the authenticated owner receipt.

asset_version_id.description: Optional exact owner target version selected by target_kind.
asset_version_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and authorized target ancestry. Exact revision must match the authenticated owner receipt.

item_version_id.description: Optional exact owner target version selected by target_kind.
item_version_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and authorized target ancestry. Exact revision must match the authenticated owner receipt.

marking_rule_version_id.description: Optional exact owner target version selected by target_kind.
marking_rule_version_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and authorized target ancestry. Exact revision must match the authenticated owner receipt.

assessment_version_id.description: Optional exact owner target version selected by target_kind.
assessment_version_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and authorized target ancestry. Exact revision must match the authenticated owner receipt.

course_version_id.description: Optional exact owner target version selected by target_kind.
course_version_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution and authorized target ancestry. Exact revision must match the authenticated owner receipt.

target_path.description: Canonical RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the authorized target or candidate; use empty pointer for whole object.

classification.description: Relationship of claim to source and author action.

link_fingerprint.description: Canonical uniqueness key over target, region, claim type, candidate revision and derivation group.

derivation_group_id.description: Groups independently indexed premise edges for the same claim.

verification_object_id.description: Protected rule, computation result, human decision or verification report.
verification_object_id.x-reference-scope: Same institution. Platform purpose evidence and exact owner CurriculumAuthoringRun. Resolve actual object version and digest before use.

recorded_by_id.description: Authorized source or owner receipt actor.
recorded_by_id.x-reference-scope: Must resolve to an authorized Principal in the owning institution.

x-invariants: Extracted, source-supported paraphrase and derived links require an accepted source region.
Derived links require a protected computation or review basis. One edge per accepted source premise; common derivation group binds premises.
Candidate-only target has no owner reference. An exact target must populate only the typed ID matching target kind.
No direct learner reads. Approved attribution is a separately filtered projection, with answer-key and source access enforced.
